items.headline: Gene Chizik: No. 9 Ole Miss needs to fix run defense
items.description: After a tough 52-28 loss to Florida, Chizik advises the Rebels to make defensive improvements to respond positively in Week 6 against Vanderbilt.

items.headline: College football's backup quarterback talent drain
items.description: How hard is it to get, hold on to and pay a backup QB in today's college football?

items.headline: Vanderbilt's Clark Lea says Curtis is day-to-day, previews Rebels
items.description: Lea says Vandy QB Jared Curtis has practiced "without much limitation" and will be evaluated daily while detailing the game plan for No. 9 Ole Miss' offensive threats.

items.headline: College Football Playoff 2026: Bubble Watch after Week 5
items.description: Putting the spotlight on select teams and questions around others as the playoff picture takes shape.

items.headline: No. 9 Ole Miss visits Vanderbilt in SEC play
items.description: No. 9 Ole Miss (3-1) at Vanderbilt (3-2), Oct. 10 at 3:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Stockton throws 3 TDs as No. 2 Georgia rolls past Vanderbilt 38-14 and improves to 5-0
items.description: — Gunner Stockton threw for 295 yards and three touchdowns as No. 2 Georgia cruised to a 38-14 win over Vanderbilt on Saturday.
